objective: Perform one read-only observation of the persistent AL Cloud Android instance through the purpose-built azl-agent interface.
screenshot_contract: Read the screen.path returned by observe with the Remote Desktop Commander image file reader.
constraints: Do not tap, type, swipe, launch, stop, or otherwise mutate Android state.
Do not use arbitrary shell exploration beyond invoking the exact observe command.
Return compact structured JSON only from the delegated worker.
